classification.difficultyReason: Use opposite-side equality to determine x and y, then compare adjacent side lengths and explain why their equality makes the rectangle a square.

content.prompt: Show that the rectangular shape shown must be a square.

spec.description: Unfilled horizontal rectangle with external labels above, below, left and right. No arrows, ticks or additional marks.
spec.mathematics: Top: 3x+5; bottom: 2x+13; left: 6y-7; right: 5y-1. Opposite sides of the given rectangle are equal. Drawn proportions do not specify side lengths.
spec.answerVisibility: All four algebraic labels are permanent student givens. No evaluated lengths or solutions appear in the question diagram.

answer.short: $x=8$, $y=6$. All four sides equal $29$, so the rectangle is a square.
answer.worked:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.

$$\begin{align*}3x+5&=2x+13\\x+5&=13\\x&=8\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}6y-7&=5y-1\\y-7&=-1\\y&=6\end{align*}$$

Substitute into each side expression:

$$\begin{align*}3(8)+5&=29\\2(8)+13&=29\\6(6)-7&=29\\5(6)-1&=29\end{align*}$$

All four sides are equal, so the rectangle is a square.
